adopt: Copy one.md into your agent's skills dir and tell it to use that skill.
description:
Kind: corpus

Problem
Prompt knowledge dies in a transcript. A skill is a procedure written once, in a file, that any agent can load when the situation calls for it.

Install
git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/awskills

Quick start
  git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/awskills
  cd awskills
  bash scripts/install-awskills.sh # Windows: pwsh -File scripts/Install-AitherSkills.ps1

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awskills/
